question: 台历首行的统计句原文是什么？
expected: 计分断言 23 条 · 排除 1 条 · 表内合计 24 条
verify:
import audit, deadlines
from datetime import date
doc = audit.load_yaml(audit.CLAIMS)
body, _, _, _ = deadlines.render(doc, date(2026, 12, 31))
result = body.splitlines()[0]
